summary: Server only. A piece on a Tabletop, made with table.addPiece. It stands on a cell, on top of the pieces already there, and its prop shows it to the table's players.

id.summary: The piece's id on its table.

table.exampleLua:
local others = {}
for _, other in ipairs(piece.table.pieces) do
  if other.side ~= piece.side then
    table.insert(others, other)
  end
end

model.summary: The prop model it is shown with.

prop.summary: The prop that shows it, for what Prop offers (its position while it moves, for example).

cell.summary: The cell it stands on (the one it moves to, from the start of a move).
cell.exampleCs:
var row = piece.Cell["row"];
var column = piece.Cell["column"];

side.summary: Whose piece it is, as you gave it to addPiece; you can change it.
side.exampleLua:
if piece.side == table.seats[table:seatOf(player)].side then
  print("your own piece")
end

data.summary: Your own data on the piece (a king's crown, a card's value), kept by save(). You can change it or assign a new object.

removed.summary: Whether it was taken off the board.

moveTo.summary: Moves it to a cell, on top of what is there: `path` 'hop' (an arc, the default), 'slide' (along the board) or 'jump' (at once), over `ms` milliseconds (default 400, at most 5000) and `height` metres up for a hop. The promise settles true when it arrives, false if it was removed or moved again first.

showOnlyTo.summary: Shows it to these players only (a card in a hand), or to everyone again with null.

params.players: A Player, a list, or null.

showOnlyTo.example: piece.showOnlyTo(null); // the card is turned face up for all
showOnlyTo.exampleLua: piece:showOnlyTo(null) -- the card is turned face up for all
showOnlyTo.exampleCs: piece.ShowOnlyTo(Sdk.Null); // the card is turned face up for all

remove.exampleLua:
local found = table:pieceAt({ 3, 3 })
if found then
  found:remove()
end
